scope: Repository workflow inventory; implemented means the bounded capability described, not Autodesk product parity.

features.name: 2D entity authoring
features.coverage: Lines, rectangles, circles, arcs, points, straight/curved polylines and text
features.limits: No spline or hatch authoring

features.name: Selection and transforms
features.coverage: Move, copy, rotate, uniform scale, mirror and multi-selection
features.limits: Unsupported text/INSERT mirror cases are refused

features.name: Grid and object snapping
features.coverage: Grid and supported geometry reference points
features.limits: No complete vendor drafting-aid set

features.name: Offsets and arrays
features.coverage: Analytic/straight and tangent-continuous curved offsets; rectangular and polar arrays
features.limits: Invalid joins, collapsing offsets and excessive arrays are refused

features.name: LINE trim and extend
features.coverage: Picked target LINE against finite LINE boundaries
features.limits: General curve trimming remains planned

features.name: Layers
features.coverage: Names, colors, visibility and assignment
features.limits: Full linetype/plot-style systems are not implemented

features.name: Reusable nested blocks
features.coverage: Definitions, references, expansion, picking and transactional explosion
features.limits: No dynamic blocks or vendor custom objects

features.name: Semantic dimensions
features.coverage: Horizontal, vertical, aligned, rotated, radius and diameter annotations
features.limits: DXF DIMENSION export is refused; full styles remain planned

features.name: Numeric commands and batch scripts
features.coverage: Shared transactional desktop command bar, CLI scripts and sketch relation commands
features.limits: Not AutoLISP, ObjectARX or vendor script compatibility

features.name: Saved viewport sheets
features.coverage: Clipping, independent scale/rotation, hidden layers and paper notes
features.limits: No DXF paper-space exchange or CTB/STB styles

features.name: Sketch constraints
features.coverage: Persistent sketch relations with a least-squares linear solver: horizontal/vertical lines, coincident/fixed points, X/Y distances, equal and absolute radii on lines, rectangles, circles, points and straight polylines (≤64 vertices)
features.limits: Linear relations only — no angular, general length/diameter dimensions, spline/arc/bulge relations or 3D sketch constraints; solves linear systems only

features.name: Specialist toolsets and extensions
features.coverage: Electrical, mechanical, MEP, plant, mapping, raster and extension workflows
features.limits: Catalog routing is not specialist toolset implementation

features.name: Parametric primitives
features.coverage: Editable boxes, cylinders and ellipsoids
features.limits: Tessellated preview/export; no general feature graph

features.name: Editable profile extrusions
features.coverage: Concave straight profiles, rectangles and circles; native parameters, desktop/CLI edits
features.limits: No holes, sketch dependencies or B-rep extrusion

features.name: Imported triangle meshes
features.coverage: Native persistence, display/picking and model-area exports
features.limits: Geometry only; no retained imported materials/textures

features.name: Analytic STEP exchange
features.coverage: Box/cylinder authoring and checked one-shell, one-solid exchange
features.limits: Separate CLI; no assemblies, multi-body files or desktop B-rep history

features.name: General solid feature history
features.coverage: Dependent sketches, booleans, fillets, shells, revolutions and robust topology
features.limits: Primitive/extrusion parameters do not establish a full modeling kernel

features.name: Assemblies and manufacturing drawings
features.coverage: Components, joints/constraints, linked drawings and revisions
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Semantic building elements
features.coverage: Storeys, straight walls, rectangular slabs and hosted door/window openings
features.limits: No curved/compound walls, arbitrary slab outlines or full families

features.name: Opening-aware geometry and quantities
features.coverage: Actual wall cutouts, net areas/volumes, native relationships and CSV schedules
features.limits: Model-unit quantities; no takeoff product parity

features.name: Families, rooms and advanced schedules
features.coverage: Parameterized reusable building systems and space semantics
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Structural, MEP and engineering analysis
features.coverage: Structural/energy systems, routing and independently validated analysis
features.limits: No engineering solver or analysis acceptance corpus

features.name: Multi-model coordination
features.coverage: Clash detection, linked models and coordination workflows
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Survey and checked TIN surfaces
features.coverage: XYZ editing, deterministic XY Delaunay triangulation and survey CSV
features.limits: 2.5D surface; no breaklines or constrained triangulation

features.name: Contours, elevations and profiles
features.coverage: TIN interpolation, contour segments, longitudinal profiles and surface exports
features.limits: Contours are unsmoothed segments; outside-surface gaps remain explicit

features.name: Line and circular-arc alignments
features.coverage: Analytic station/offset queries, left-positive offsets and terrain profiles
features.limits: No spirals, station equations, design standards or corridors

features.name: Cut/fill against a level datum
features.coverage: Exact integration after clipping each TIN triangle by datum height
features.limits: No arbitrary TIN-to-TIN comparison or grading optimizer

features.name: Corridors, grading and drainage
features.coverage: Road assemblies, grading rules, hydrology and drainage networks
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Utility networks, assets and geospatial systems
features.coverage: Network/asset workflows, CRS transformation and project standards
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Compensated profile machining
features.coverage: Rectangle/circle/straight-polygon contours, stock/tool setup and depth passes
features.limits: Single-tool bounded 2.5D operations

features.name: Pocket milling with islands
features.coverage: Rectangular, circular and polygon clearing with checked uncut islands
features.limits: No adaptive strategy, ramping, tool changes or multi-axis paths

features.name: Peck drilling
features.coverage: Point-based incremental depth plunges with full clearance retracts
features.limits: Explicit moves; no controller-specific canned cycles

features.name: Motion preview and generic posting
features.coverage: Checked cutter footprints, travel/depth limits and generic millimetre G-code
features.limits: No machine acceptance, acceleration model or stock-removal simulation

features.name: Production CAM and postprocessors
features.coverage: Tools, machine posts, adaptive/ramped and multi-axis operations
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Stock, collision and engineering simulation
features.coverage: Stock removal, fixtures, collisions, FEA/CFD and manufacturing validation
features.limits: Motion previews do not provide these solvers

features.name: Additive, nesting and manufacturing management
features.coverage: Slicing, build preparation, nesting, inspection and manufacturing services
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Colored primitive scene graph
features.coverage: Persistent objects, checked parent references and composed affine transforms
features.limits: No vendor dependency graph or scene format compatibility

features.name: Transform animation and playback
features.coverage: Translation/scale/Euler keys, linear/step/smoothstep interpolation and visibility inheritance
features.limits: No quaternion curves, per-channel tangents or rig animation

features.name: Editable modifier stack
features.coverage: Local-space arrays and mirrored copies with outward winding
features.limits: Eight modifiers and 128 copies per object; no general deformation stack

features.name: Rigging, skinning and animation constraints
features.coverage: Skeletons, deformation, animation controllers and production animation
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Materials, lighting and production rendering
features.coverage: Shaders, lighting, cameras and offline rendering
features.limits: Colored viewport primitives are not a production renderer

features.name: Dynamics and compositing
features.coverage: Physics, particles, effects, compositing and production interchange
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Local issue/review board
features.coverage: Descriptions, references, priority/status lifecycle, search and CSV
features.limits: References are descriptive text; no cloud identity or synchronization

features.name: Accounts, permissions and synchronization
features.coverage: Multi-user projects, identity, permissions, revisions and coordination services
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Vendor cloud/service compatibility
features.coverage: Connected Autodesk account/project/service workflows
features.limits: No vendor integration or acceptance data

features.name: Native JSON persistence
features.coverage: Version 7, validated atomic writes and v1-v6 migration
features.limits: Project-specific format; no Autodesk native compatibility implied

features.name: ASCII DXF subset
features.coverage: Analytic drawing entities, units, layers, nested blocks and strict loss diagnostics
features.limits: No binary DXF, semantic dimension export, paper space, hatches, splines or proxies

features.name: DWG/DWT/DWS engine workflow
features.coverage: acadrust-supported entities; CLI read/write with R2000/R2018 output checks
features.limits: Desktop DWG editing and full vendor fidelity remain unverified

features.name: Geometry-only OBJ/STL
features.coverage: ASCII/binary STL, OBJ polygon triangulation and checked mesh output
features.limits: No materials, animation, unit metadata or editable CAD parameters

features.name: Remaining Autodesk native formats
features.coverage: RVT/RFA, IPT/IAM, F3D/F3Z, MAX, MA/MB, FBX, NWD/NWC, RCS/RCP and DWF
features.limits: No integrated implementation or native acceptance corpus

features.name: Further open interchange
features.coverage: IFC, IGES, SAT, USD and Alembic workflows
features.limits: Not implemented

features.name: Undo/redo and transactional edits
features.coverage: Document snapshots and validated candidate edits across native workbenches
features.limits: No cross-session recovery journal

features.name: Linux verification
features.coverage: Workspace tests, native launch/edit/reopen cases and artifact hashes
features.limits: Tests prove their stated bounded cases

features.name: Installers and cross-platform releases
features.coverage: Packaged Windows/macOS/Linux installs, migration and recovery acceptance
features.limits: Only local Linux binaries have been verified

features.name: Originating-product acceptance
features.coverage: Versioned fixtures checked in each originating application
features.limits: No Autodesk installation or authoritative fixture corpus connected

features.name: Supplied Rust pattern audit
features.coverage: All workspace Rust files scanned; focused new-code remediation: fallible authoring APIs (add_geometry/add_solid/add_layer/add_mesh/add_block/duplicate_entities), reachable panic hardening and recorded hashes/findings
features.limits: Raw strict gate remains non-clean (test assertions and legacy invariants); the confirmed object-ID exhaustion panic is fixed and covered by tests
